Spray captan 50% wettable powder (50 WP): Spray captan 50% wettable powder (50 WP) at 2.5 grams per litre of water or mancozeb 75% wettable powder (75 WP) at 2.5 grams per litre of water from green-tip stage at 10-14 day intervals in wet weather. Rake and destroy fallen leaves.

Use resistant hybrids and rotate crops;: Use resistant hybrids and rotate crops; spray mancozeb at 2.5 grams per litre of water or propiconazole at 1 ml per litre of water at early symptoms.

No cure. Remove and destroy infected tre: No cure. Remove and destroy infected trees, control the citrus psyllid vector (e.g. imidacloprid as per label), and plant certified disease-free saplings.
Use disease-free seed/transplants; spray: Use disease-free seed/transplants; spray copper oxychloride 50% wettable powder (50 WP) at 3 grams per litre of water, optionally with streptocycline at 0.1 grams per litre of water where permitted. Avoid working with wet plants.
Spray mancozeb 75% wettable powder (75 W: Spray mancozeb 75% wettable powder (75 WP) at 2.5 grams per litre of water or chlorothalonil at 2 grams per litre of water at 10-day intervals from first symptoms; remove lower infected leaves and rotate crops.
